purpose: Brand-free task-content recommendation; source identities are diagnostic labels only, never ranking inputs.

cases.zh: 我们两个人准备出去玩五天，预算总共六千。帮我把交通、酒店、吃饭和门票算清楚，超了就给出取舍方案。
cases.en: Two of us have a total budget of six thousand for a five-day trip. Work out transport, hotels, meals and admission costs and propose trade-offs if it goes over.
cases.capability: 核算旅行总预算并给出取舍

cases.zh: 这篇中文论文要投英文期刊，请翻译摘要和方法，保留公式、引用和术语的一致性。
cases.en: Translate this Chinese paper abstract and methods for an English journal while preserving equations, citations and consistent terminology.
cases.capability: 学术翻译并保留公式引用

cases.zh: 升级这个前端依赖后接口变了，帮我找到当前版本的官方文档和能用的代码示例，别套用旧版本。
cases.en: After upgrading this frontend dependency its API changed. Find the official documentation and working examples for this version rather than applying the old API.
cases.capability: 检索版本相关官方开发文档

cases.zh: 接口平时还行，一到晚高峰就慢。设计突发流量实验，定位是CPU还是数据库等待，再对比优化后的延迟和吞吐量。
cases.en: The API is fine normally but slows during evening bursts. Design a burst-load experiment, distinguish CPU time from database waits and compare latency and throughput after tuning.
cases.capability: 负载实验、定位瓶颈和验证调优

cases.zh: 我每个月手工记收支很容易算错。做一个能修改数据就自动算总额的工作簿，整理好货币格式，并检查重算结果。
cases.en: I keep miscalculating monthly income and spending. Make an editable workbook that automatically totals changes, formats currencies consistently and verifies recalculated totals.
cases.capability: 可编辑公式工作簿与重算验证

cases.zh: 我要了解这个行业的技术路线，安排研究者分头搜资料，再核实来源、审稿和汇总，最终要带引用的报告。
cases.en: I need a report on this industrys technical directions: coordinate researchers, independently verify their sources, review drafts and assemble a cited report.
cases.capability: 多角色多源研究和引用报告

cases.zh: 新系统需要一整套架构方案：业务、系统、部署、安全和用户故事之间要交接产物，让相关专家协作完成。
cases.en: Our new system needs a complete architecture package with artifact handoffs across business, system, deployment, security and user-story specialists.
cases.capability: 完整架构团队交付与产物交接

cases.zh: 本地商城更新后，我不确定购物车到结账还能不能跑通。请实际操作浏览器，保存截图并检查控制台错误。
cases.en: After updating my local shop I am unsure whether cart-to-checkout still works. Operate the browser, retain screenshots and inspect console errors.
cases.capability: 浏览器真实业务流程与证据

cases.zh: 准备给不同城市的员工核对社保和住房公积金政策，需要缴费基数、比例、截止日期以及政策原文链接。
cases.en: For employees in several Chinese cities, find social-insurance and housing-fund contribution bases, ratios, filing deadlines and original policy links.
cases.capability: 社保公积金政策及来源，不是办理缴费

cases.zh: 几份扫描账单混在一起了，先提取文字和表格，再把我选中的页面按顺序合成一份新文件。
cases.en: Several scanned statements are mixed together. Extract their text and tables, then combine the selected pages in order into a new document.
cases.capability: 扫描文档提取和页面合并

cases.zh: 支付需求还没开始写代码，先把正常状态、异常流转和金额边界推导成测试场景，并能追溯到业务规则。
cases.en: Before coding the payment feature, derive test scenarios for valid states, invalid transitions and amount boundaries, traceable to the business rules.
cases.capability: 业务规则到可追溯测试设计

cases.zh: 给通知偏好做完整开发交付：澄清需求，拆成独立任务，先写失败测试，分别审查规格和代码质量，最后集成。
cases.en: Deliver notification preferences end to end: clarify requirements, split independent tasks, write failing tests first, separately review specification compliance and code quality, then integrate.
cases.capability: 完整开发编排与双重审查

limitations: New paraphrases of existing capabilities, not an unseen-domain benchmark; the diagnostic and validation splits are frozen before running this experiment.
No Skill, expert, connector or service name is required in these queries. Diagnostic labels are incomplete; equivalent modules require a separate functional relevance review.
Recommendation does not authorize business access or execute a module. Actual credentials, price, host compatibility and task completion are not tested by retrieval.
